HONEST ACCOUNTING (repo discipline \u2014 see SkyStrategy/MorphoStrategy audits): - `corePrincipal6`  = net USDC we sent to Core (never counted as yield). - `coreEquity6`     = Core account value, refreshed by syncCore() reads. - profit on Core    = equity - principal; only the EXCESS is realizable. - `profitRealized`  = profit actually bridged back to EVM (underlying units). - harvest() by the VAULT sweeps realized profit above the liquidity buffer   to the vault; by the keeper it only syncs (settle, no movement). ASYNC RECALL (CoreWriter actions are fire-and-forget + delayed seconds): - This contract keeps `bufferBps` of assets idle on EVM for instant vault   recalls (BaseStrategy.recall is vault-only, transfers idle balance). - Larger recalls: keeper unwinds first (moveUsdcToSpot -> bridgeBackToEvm),   then the vault recalls. owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setPerpAsset(uint32).details: Only while the position is flat — avoids reinterpreting an open hedge.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

bridgeBackToEvm(uint64).notice: Return USDC Core->EVM (sendAsset to the USDC system address). Requires HYPE on Core for transfer gas. Splits the amount into principal vs profit at the FRESHLY-SYNCED equity: profit = amount above remaining principal. Only realized profit can ever be harvested.

bridgeUsdcToCore(uint256).notice: Bridge USDC EVM->Core (lands in the contract's SPOT balance). Initializes the Core account; actions must be sent in a LATER block.

coreScale().notice: Scale from Core 6dp USDC to underlying token units (1 for real USDC; 1e12 for an 18-decimals test token).

delegateHype(address,uint64,bool).notice: Delegate / undelegate staked HYPE to a validator (action 3).

harvestableProfit().notice: Realized profit still waiting to be swept (underlying units).

marginSummary().notice: NOTE: takes (perpDexIndex, user) — verified against mainnet.

moveUsdcToPerp(uint64).notice: Move USDC spot→perp (or back) on Core. `ntl` is USDC perp units (6 decimals; 1 USDC = 1e6).

openShort(uint32,uint64,uint64,uint8).notice: Open the short hedge (sell perp). limitPx/sz are 10^8 × human value; sz must respect the asset's szDecimals (keeper reads 0x80a).

perpAsset().notice: HyperCore perp asset index (0 = BTC, 1 = ETH on validator perps).

recall(uint256).notice: Return funds to the vault so it can honor user withdrawals. Callable ONLY by the vault address (set via setVault). Capped at balance.

stakeHype(uint64).notice: Stake HYPE held on the contract's Core spot balance (action 4). Owner-gated: policy op, not routine keeper work.

syncCore().notice: Refresh Core equity + position from HyperCore state. Permissionless: it only records what the precompiles report.

totalAssets().notice: Strategy assets in underlying units (synced Core equity + idle).

withdrawStake(uint64).notice: Withdraw HYPE from staking back to Core spot (action 5).
